stem: The film ____ tells of an adventure is very interesting.
expl: that 引导定语从句,可以修饰物;此处 that 在从句中作主语,修饰先行词 the film。

stem: This is the photo ____ we liked best.
expl: which 引导定语从句修饰物,在从句中作 liked 的宾语。who 只指人,what 不能引导定语从句。

stem: The animals ____ live in the forest need our protection.
expl: that 引导定语从句,可修饰人也可修饰物,此处修饰 the animals 并在从句中作主语。

stem: The writer ____ I like best is Mark Twain.
expl: that 既可修饰人也可修饰物;此处修饰指人的先行词 the writer,并在从句中作 like 的宾语。which 不能指人。

stem: A group of photos ____ show our city won the prize.
expl: which 引导定语从句修饰物 photos,并在从句中作主语。

stem: The organisation ____ protects endangered animals started ten years ago.
expl: that 引导定语从句修饰 the organisation 并在从句中作主语。

stem: Please read the notice ____ is on the wall.
expl: that 引导定语从句修饰物 the notice,在从句中作主语,故不能省略。

stem: The rubbish ____ people drop in the park harms wild animals.
expl: that 引导定语从句修饰 the rubbish,在从句中作 drop 的宾语。

stem: The tourist we met yesterday ____ from Australia.
expl: we met yesterday 是省略了引导词的定语从句,修饰 the tourist;句子的主语仍是单数 the tourist,故主句谓语用 is。

stem: The gas ____ cars give out affects the air.
expl: which 引导定语从句修饰物 the gas,在从句中作 give out 的宾语。

stem: The solar panel ____ they put on the roof works well.
expl: that 引导定语从句修饰 the solar panel,在从句中作 put 的宾语。

stem: In the sentence "The alarm we heard last night was very loud", the words "we heard last night" ____.
opts: ask a question about the alarm
act as the main clause of the sentence
tell us who bought the alarm
tell us which alarm is being talked about
expl: we heard last night 是省略了引导词的定语从句,用来说明是哪一个 alarm;主句是 The alarm … was very loud。

stem: In which sentence can the word THAT be LEFT OUT?
opts: The alarm that rings at seven wakes me up.
The guard that stands at the gate is friendly.
The photo that we took by the river is lovely.
The rubbish that lies on the ground harms animals.
expl: 引导词在从句中作宾语时可以省略,作主语时不能省略。C 项的 that 是 took 的宾语,可省;A、B、D 三项的 that 都是从句主语,省略后从句就没有主语了。

stem: Choose the sentence that has a relative clause with NO relative word.
opts: The tourist we met at the station came from far away.
The tourist who met us was very kind.
We do not know who met the tourist.
Which tourist met you at the station?
expl: A 项中 we met at the station 修饰 the tourist,是省略了引导词的定语从句。B 项引导词 who 仍在;C 项是宾语从句;D 项是疑问句。

opts: The man which helped us is a guard.
The plan who we made is working.
The river which we cleaned it is clean now.
The plan that we made last year is working now.
expl: which 只能指物、不能指人,故 A 错;who 只能指人、不能指物,故 B 错;C 项的引导词 which 已在从句中作宾语,后面不应再出现 it;D 项 that 修饰物且在从句中作 made 的宾语,正确。
